verdict.rationale: The docs say Transaction Aggregation data refreshes daily and can be refreshed on demand through dedicated Data Refresh endpoints when fresher data is needed. The Account Balance service also offers real-time versus cached balance retrieval. However, the pack only points to the Data Refresh documentation without showing its content, so the refresh semantics are only partly evidenced. Missing for 10: the documented refresh semantics themselves (sync vs. async behavior, completion signaling, rate limits or refresh frequency caps, per-account vs. per-customer scope), endpoint-level detail, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can trigger an on-demand refresh of a connected account's data through the API when my use case needs now-fresh data, with the refresh semantics documented

citations.quote: Although Transaction Aggregation data refreshes daily, you may sometimes need more recent data. Transaction Aggregation can be refreshed using the endpoints described in Data Refresh
The Account Balance service provides real-time or cached bank account balance information from your customer's Financial Institution (FI).
